name: Hasselelponi
title: Woman in Judah's Genealogy
summary: Hasselelponi is a woman mentioned in 1 Chronicles within the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. She is the daughter of Etam and sister to Jizreel, Ishma, and Jedidah. Although she is only briefly mentioned, she is part of the important lineage that connects the tribe of Judah to the royal house of David.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hasselelponi is mentioned as the daughter of Etam in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles. She is listed among the descendants of Hur, Caleb's son.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Etam
keyEvents.description: Etsam had three sons – Jisreel, Jisma and Jidbas – as well as the daughter Hasselelponi. This lineage belongs to the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of Hur's lineage
keyEvents.description: Hasselelponi belongs to the lineage of Hur, who was the son of Caleb and Efrata. This line held great significance in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: 1 Chronicles opens with extensive genealogies establishing the prominence of the tribe of Judah, and Hasselelponi is part of this important genealogical overview.
